read.thesis: Alphabet Q3 CY26: Cloud revenue +103% to $30.7B with margin 36.2%, but capex $51.4B, FCF -$9.1B and $561B backlog; supply is tight, with third-party capacity bridging and TPU system sales adding inventory.

utilisation.quote: we could obviously serve a lot more demand with capacity, but we are managing all of these parameters and growth carefully.

capex.quote: Our full year 2026 CapEx guidance range of $195 billion to $205 billion remain unchanged.

triggers.label: Capex guide held at $195-205B; 2027 to rise
triggers.quote: We continue to expect our CapEx to increase significantly in 2027

triggers.label: Inventory $2.4B → $13.3B for TPU builds
triggers.quote: Inventory Balance -- $13.3 billion, up from $2.4 billion at year-end 2025 due to the buildup for TPU system sales.

triggers.label: Cloud backlog $561B; ~55% in 24 months
triggers.quote: Google Cloud's backlog was $561 billion in the third quarter

triggers.label: Cloud margin 23.7% → 36.2%
triggers.quote: Operating margin increased from 23.7% in the third quarter last year to 36.2%.

triggers.label: Cloud margin headwind from 3P compute
triggers.quote: We expect margin headwinds in the near term as we utilize this capacity.

guidance.quote: Our full year 2026 CapEx guidance range of $195 billion to $205 billion remain unchanged.

guidance.value: Pressured by lapping ~3 pts of acceleration plus FX
guidance.quote: we expect to see that continue in Q4, a couple of points of lapping that growth acceleration

red_flags.label: FCF negative $9.1B in quarter
red_flags.quote: We had negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion in the third quarter

red_flags.label: Future purchase commitments $924B
red_flags.quote: we had future purchase commitments of $924 billion

red_flags.label: Search decel with AI Mode monetisation lag
red_flags.quote: the strong growth in AI Mode queries had an impact because of the lower monetization we were seeing in AI Mode

evasions.quote: we don't break out margins for individual products or infrastructure components.
Cloud revenue growth, excluding the impact of TPU system sales was again very, very strong.

evasions.topic: Compute allocation between internal and external
evasions.quote: I would broadly think of all of this as a long-range planning process, not a short-term allocation exercise.
